# Accuracy analysis: c-cpython-autogenerated-code

Measured 2026-10-13 on main 3f7c2b64 (`benchmark_optimal_solutions`, `painting_failure_census`,
`mismatch_detail_for_fixture`, `painting_disagreement_detail`). The engine changes; re-measure
before relying on these numbers.

## Numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| Mapping mismatches | 5 (0 visible) of 57917 nodes, 57917 graded, N:M floor 0 visible |
| Painting, Minimal | 18 bytes wrong of 284762: renderer 18, matcher 0 |
| Painting, Full | 18 bytes wrong of 284762: renderer 58, matcher 40 |
| Ground-truth invariant violations | none |

## The change

cpython `Python/optimizer_cases.c.h` (generated, ~140 KB): in one case, `tuple_length` is
renamed `length`, a 16-line block that computes the length of constant str/bytes arguments is
inserted (after lines 3313-3328), and a two-line `ADD_OP(_SHUFFLE_3_LOAD_CONST_INLINE_BORROW,
0, (uintptr_t)temp);` is joined onto one line (before 3319-3320 -> after 3335).

## Mapping

- **The rejoined `ADD_OP(...)` call, 5 invisible.** Same pairs as the ground truth; the ground
  truth labels the `if`, its block, the statement, the call and its argument list
  `MatchButNotIdentical` because a line break inside them was removed, while omnidiff labels them
  `Identical` (whitespace does not count in its hashes). Only the operation label differs, on
  nodes no reader sees. `grading-artifact`.

## Painting

- **Minimal, Update -> Delete, 18 bytes:** the `tuple_` prefix of `tuple_length` on before lines
  3312-3314. omnidiff renders the rename as an Update narrowed to the removed prefix; the
  painting deletes the prefix. The same with the human mapping. `renderer`.
- **Full, Move -> None, 18 bytes:** the unchanged tails `>= 0) {` and `);` of the renamed lines
  (before 3313-3314, after 3329-3330), shifted left by the shorter name and down 16 rows by the
  insert. Full paints them Move; the painting leaves an identical line tail alone. The same with
  the human mapping. `renderer`. Rendering the human mapping additionally paints the rejoined
  `0, (uintptr_t)temp);` Move (40 bytes) because it maps the call `MatchButNotIdentical`;
  omnidiff's `Identical` avoids that, so here omnidiff's mapping renders better than the human
  one (`matcher_bytes` 40 is in omnidiff's favour).

## Verdict

- Primary cause: `renderer`
- Other causes: `grading-artifact`
- Where a fix would go: `diff::text`: rename narrowing (Update vs Delete of a removed prefix) and
  Full Move on shifted identical line tails
- Ground truth questionable: no
